name: google-workspace-plugins
description: Native Claude Code & Codex plugin marketplace for Google Workspace and Google Suite CLI (gog & gws)

plugins.name: gog-gmail
plugins.description: Gmail inbox management, message triage, draft preparation, sending with confirmation, and thread followup tracking using the gog CLI.

plugins.name: gog-calendar
plugins.description: Google Calendar scheduling, agenda inspection, free/busy slot queries, and conflict-free meeting creation with the gog CLI.

plugins.name: gog-drive-docs-sheets
plugins.description: Google Drive file management, markdown Docs export, Sheets tabular read/write, and Slides creation using the gog CLI.

plugins.name: gog-tasks
plugins.description: Google Tasks management, task list synchronization, due date tracking, and task completion with the gog CLI.

plugins.name: gog-suite
plugins.description: Unified multi-account Google Suite CLI (gog) integration across Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, Contacts, Tasks, Keep, and Admin.

plugins.name: gws-gmail
plugins.description: Google Workspace Gmail automation: search, threads, draft composition, labels, NDJSON mailbox change streams, and automated triage via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-calendar
plugins.description: Google Workspace Calendar operations: agenda inspection, Meet links, attendee invites, focus blocks, and schedule conflict resolution via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-drive-docs-sheets
plugins.description: Google Workspace Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides operations: cloud file management, document creation, spreadsheet ETL, and slide deck generation via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-tasks
plugins.description: Google Workspace Tasks operations: task list management, overdue audits, and automated email-to-task conversions via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-chat-meet
plugins.description: Google Workspace Chat and Meet operations: space messaging, participant logs, conference creation, and team announcements via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-people
plugins.description: Google Workspace People & Contacts operations: directory search, profile lookups, and contact directory synchronization to spreadsheets via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-forms-keep
plugins.description: Google Workspace Forms and Keep notes operations: survey creation, response collection, and team onboarding workflows via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-admin-security
plugins.description: Google Workspace Admin reports, Classroom courses, Apps Script deployment, Workspace events, and Model Armor safety filters via gws CLI.

plugins.name: gws-workflows-core
plugins.description: Google Workspace orchestration suite: pre-flight diagnostics, setup guides, recipe runner, cross-service workflows (standup report, meeting prep, weekly digest), and executive management via gws CLI.
